key_points: Most headlines are routine market commentary or syndicated 'upside potential' articles with no substantive new information — noise.
Largest potentially meaningful item is the buyback expansion narrative from simplywall.st, which could provide modest support if executed.
Analyst price target optimism (Truist) and new institutional investment (Bank of America) are routine and not thesis-changing.
Institutional selling (Corient Private Wealth) is offsetting but immaterial at headline level.
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, regulatory/legal events, or M&A present to shift the investment thesis.
